bindings.role: Frozen independent original STOP/later reused-identity review; 7 approved current identities, 8 original known-birth proofs, 659 historical process files
Root execution log, 59 tests OK, read only
Root summary: final 59 unique cases, 0 failures/errors/skips, replaces prior 39 rather than adding reruns

checks.detail: Optional review requires path and lowercase SHA together. Without it, any fresh native match of a historical producer PID remains a rejection, including PID reuse.

checks.check: Optional review is specific and revalidated
checks.detail: Consumer reloads the accepted review by SHA, checks exact D102 scope/private root/server PID/D101 gate, original no-submission FAILED output and readonly diagnostic, and requires the complete current historical-process inventory to equal the frozen full manifest. Each quiescence boundary reruns this validation and samples fresh authoritative CIM.

checks.check: Original known births and complete tree proof
checks.detail: Each admitted original PID/birth must match frozen START/STOP or child sidecar evidence. Complete exit/tree/bridge flags, invocation and request hashes, child sidecar hashes, observed parent chain and actual bridge identity are checked. Nanosecond-safe UTC comparison requires original stop strictly before the approved current OS birth. Every historical occurrence of an admitted PID must have a unique known reviewed birth; unknown or unreviewed births reject.

checks.check: Current identity exactness and fail-closed sampling
checks.detail: Fresh Win32_Process records preserve PID, name, UTC OS birth, parent PID and executable (including an explicitly frozen null). Unexpected/duplicate/server PID, malformed identity or CIM failure rejects. A present PID is admitted only if its entire identity equals the frozen approved value; a new reuse or unapproved PID rejects.

Only the exact private original CREATE VIEW is admitted. An existing claim with UNKNOWN blocks even when the view exists; an acknowledged claim with absent view also cannot resubmit. Missing-only CREATE requires fresh quiescence, unchanged five-table frontiers, source/schema verification and private attestation, then saves durable UNKNOWN before the single driver call. Exception or timeout leaves UNKNOWN; there is no retry, replacement, source write, publisher or refresh path.

checks.check: Formal readonly and transport limits unchanged
checks.detail: Formal records remain SELECT-only at localhost:8812; create_view requires isolated=true and exact target. PG connect remains 10 seconds, execution/read callback deadline 20 seconds. Any failure closes the owned connection, restores the prior callback and propagates; there is no empty-result fallback or automatic replay. Private/formal HTTP deadlines and output scope remain explicit.

Tests cover durable intent before one driver call, UNKNOWN refusal, default reused-PID refusal, explicit identity/manifest/review drift, missing old proof, native failure and callback restoration. Root's frozen 59-case log/summary were read; reviewer did not execute them.

caveats: This review is static and filesystem-only. It does not perform fresh CIM sampling, database queries, DDL, service or owner invocations, ledger recovery, or Java/Python test execution.

Saved approved OS identities are not a reusable general PID allowlist. Script execution must reload the exact review and full historical hashes, check ledger quiescence, freshly sample native identities and re-attest the fixed private instance at its guarded boundaries.

The independent identity review permits only a new explicitly admitted pre-CREATE attempt after an unsubmitted earlier failure. It neither converts an UNKNOWN CREATE to acknowledged nor changes any original failure/STOP marker or historical ledger writerStopped value.
An approved unrelated reused PID may disappear, but any present match must remain exact; changes during the audit fail closed. No automatic kill, service restart or fallback identity is introduced.
D102 source completeness, full-history freshness, cache hit and production cutover remain outside this review. D103 is not admitted.
